steps: Inventory sacred heritage for political theology assessment & diagnostics using UNESCO criteria and condition assessment
Design preservation plan with conservation standards and community stewardship
Implement restoration with qualified conservators and traditional craftspeople
Deploy monitoring with condition reporting and community guardianship
Evaluate preservation outcomes through condition assessment and community surveys
treatments.monitoring: PHASE 1 (Weeks 1-4): Baseline — heritage site preservation using sacred site condition survey. Deliverable: baseline report. PHASE 2 (Months 2-3): Early tracking — heritage site preservation measured annually. Target: 90% sacred sites maintained. PHASE 3 (Months 4-6): Midpoint review — compare against ICOMOS conservation standards. Target: 50% of goal. PHASE 4 (Months 7-12): Maturation — heritage site preservation trending toward 95% maintained. Escalate if <80% maintained floor. ANNUAL REVIEW: Comprehensive audit using UNESCO/ICOMOS framework. Report to Sacred Heritage Director.
treatments.escalation: If target outcome shows no measurable improvement after 180 days, or if implementation barriers prevent protocol adherence for >30 consecutive days, escalate to a systematic theology and doctrine specialist for root cause analysis and intervention redesign.
